backend_cidr.description: List of CIDR blocks for allowed backend addresses

backend_port.description: Backend port number (optional, inherits from listen if not set)

default_hostname.description: Default SNI hostname if client provides none

listen.description: List of socket addresses or paths to listen on

mode.description: Operation mode: unix, tcp, or nat46

nat46_prefix.description: IPv6 prefix for NAT46 source translation

unix_directory.description: Directory containing backend UNIX sockets (required in unix mode)
